metadata.method_name: physics-prior-mean residual GP with an output-restricted sensitivity kernel
metadata.description: Candidate D of a five-way kernel screen on the IEEE PES European LV feeder: a train-calibrated multiphase LinDistFlow prediction is the GP prior mean and the output-restricted sensitivity kernel exp(-||S(x-x')||^2/(2 l^2)) is placed on the residual, with a train-only noise-floor tempering selected by leave-one-out coverage matching. Six prediction columns per fold: physics mean alone, zero-mean operator kernel, physics-plus-residual GP by marginal likelihood, two alpha-tempered variants, and a plain ridge on the residual with classical ridge intervals.
metadata.protocol: 12 seeds x 2 partition schemes = 24 folds per training size
metadata.screen_metric_definition: mean paired margin of the physics-plus-residual GP (tempered intervals, point prediction identical to the marginal-likelihood arm) over the best of the five named baselines in the same fold, at n=80 on the 2.0x regime, averaged over 24 folds

R1_small_n_crossing_at_10.interpretation: at n=10 the 47-parameter physics calibration nearly interpolates the training rows, so the residual GP has almost nothing left to fit and this arm is approximately the physics baseline by construction

R1_small_n_crossing_at_20.interpretation: at n=10 the 47-parameter physics calibration nearly interpolates the training rows, so the residual GP has almost nothing left to fit and this arm is approximately the physics baseline by construction

R3_coverage_repair.rule: usable if, at every n from 10 to 160, |c68-0.68|<=0.05 and |c95-0.95|<=0.05

S3_no_candidate_beats_D_by_15pct.note: the other four screened artifacts run in parallel and reading them is forbidden, so this is not evaluable inside this artifact

departures: No neural-network baseline: at 10-160 AC solves a DNN is outside its data regime; the claim is about which kernel to use at small n, not about kernels beating neural networks.
One feeder, one 15-bus far-end sheet, one load model: external validity is asserted for this feeder only and the crossover number is not generalised.
No measurement noise: ground truth is a deterministic function of the injection vector, so the GP noise term is a regulariser and calibration is read off empirical coverage.

The graph metrics are 55x55 and slice the load-magnitude block, so P and Q share one metric; this flatters the treatment's margin if anything and is recorded rather than claimed as the strongest possible phase-aware graph kernel.
No topology change / N-1 adaptation: out of scope for a fixed-topology kernel screen.

ac_solves.note: one no-load three-phase solve for the reference phasors, zero for the analytic operator
